Diego —

Thanks for sending these over. I attached Mosaic's initial redlines to the MSA (Mosaic_MSA_Counterparty_Redlines.docx). High-level requests from our side:

- DPA & data processing terms: we prefer an inline DPA with clear subprocessor obligations and a 30-day vendor notice for subprocessor changes.
- Audit & access: limit annual audit to written requests and narrow scope for production systems.
- Indemnity & cap: propose a mutual limitation of liability with a cap tied to 12 months of fees and carveouts for gross negligence.
- Data residency: we require EU customer data to remain in EU-hosted infrastructure unless explicitly approved.

A couple of questions: do you have a completed list of Redwood subprocessors and your SOC 2 report? Also please confirm who will receive the invoice (billing@ or PO to procurement).

We are aiming to close procurement in the next 3 weeks but need legal agreement on the above items before committing to implementation dates. Happy to hop on a call — I'm available Mon afternoon (EST).

Regards,
